thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 502/504s detected from API gateway in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Error rate > 8% over 5m. Paging oncall-sre and infra-ops.
oncall-sre: I'm on it. starting checklist — gathering scope and blast radius.
infra-ops: seeing spike at edge -> 502 fanout to backend pools. TL;DR: upstream timeouts and 502s from apigw.
support-lead: Customers reporting failed uploads and timeouts in the Studio and Inference endpoints. Several support tickets opened. Some retries still 502.
oncall-sre: can someone paste a short tail of gateway logs? need error signatures.
infra-ops: pasting sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:18:21Z apigw[edge-proxy] "POST /v1/generate" 502 upstream_timeout route=ai-gen region=eu-west-1
2026-03-15T02:18:23Z apigw[edge-proxy] "POST /v1/chat" 504 backend_deadline_exceeded route=chat-service region=us-east-1
```
platform-eng: looks like backend service connection spikes coinciding with a config rollout to v2 routing policy ~02:12 UTC.
product-ops: was there an intended rollout at ~02:10? I saw a canary earlier but thought it was small.
eve: I kicked off a traffic-weight change at 02:10 to send 10% to variant v2 for perf tests. rolling back now.
oncall-sre: hold on rollback until we confirm causality. if v2 has different keepalive settings it could cause more upstream errors.
infra-ops: load graph: increased 95th p90 connection time to backend pool by 300ms after rollout; retry storms observed from edge.
support-lead: immediate ask: do we have a mitigation to reduce customer impact now? customers hitting retries and hitting rate limits.
oncall-sre: steps: 1) reduce client retry bursts via edge rate-limiter 2) engage circuit breaker on problematic backend pool 3) disable v2 traffic split if safe.
platform-eng: I'm enabling a temporary 50rps per-client soft limit at the edge to dampen retries. applying now.
infra-ops: enabling circuit breaker for pool ai-backend-12 (eu-west-1) -> tripped threshold 5xx rate. Switching to healthy pool ai-backend-09.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: policy update applied to edge-rate-limiter service (change id: rl-20260315-03). No downtime expected.
oncall-sre: confirm failing pool cutover status?
infra-ops: cutover completed at 02:24 UTC. error rate dropped from 9.1% -> 3.2% in eu-west-1 within 3m.
eve: rolling back v2 split from 10% -> 0% now to remove variable. completed 02:26 UTC.
product-ops: any customer-visible cleanup? support got temporary mitigation note.
support-lead: posting canned message to affected ticket threads: "We're seeing elevated 5xx responses from the gateway; mitigations in progress. We'll follow up in 30m with status." sending now.
oncall-sre: additional next steps: collect traces for 02:08-02:30 window, run heap/conn checks on ai-backend-12, and set up alert suppress for related downstream flapping so we don't drown SRE.
platform-eng: adding short-term suppression for downstream alerts tied to the failing pool. will keep top-level apigw alert active.
infra-ops: preliminary root cause looks like the v2 variant had a shorter backend keepalive + slightly higher connection churn under retries leading to resource pressure on ai-backend-12. we're going to stress test v2 on staging with keepalive changes.
oncall-sre: good. timeline summary for postmortem: 02:10 rollout to v2 (10%), 02:12 connection latency climb, 02:18 502/504 spike paging triggered, 02:24 circuit breaker + pool switch, 02:26 v2 rollback, 02:29 error rate returned to baseline ~0.8%.
product-ops: any SLA/customer action items? how long were customers impacted?
support-lead: impact window ~02:12-02:29 UTC. highest error rate window ~02:18-02:25. tickets flagged for escalation: 7 high-priority customer reports.
eve: noted. will coordinate with QA to reproduce with keepalive toggles.
oncall-sre: assigning follow-ups: infra-ops -> deep backend health and connection tuning; platform-eng -> rollback safety & canary gating; product-ops + support-lead -> customer comms + incident blurb.
infra-ops: copying commands used for mitigation:
```
# cut traffic off failing pool
kubectl patch srvc ai-backend-12 -p '{"spec":{"weight":0}}'
# enable circuit breaker
curl -X POST "https://ops-api/route/circuit" -d '{"pool":"ai-backend-12","mode":"trip"}'
```
support-lead: thanks. I'll update affected customers and tag postmortem when draft is ready.
oncall-sre: marking incident as mitigated but keep monitoring for 2 hours. will open a postmortem ticket and assign owners.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated (mitigation_time=4801234760). Pager: cleared. :white_check_mark:
platform-eng: leaving alert rules in place for auto-rollbacks if future canary causes >=5% 5xx in 5m.
oncall-sre: good work team. follow-up sync in 1 hour to agree on RCA and timeline for permanent fix.
